litigation.mdlName: In re: Bard Implanted Port Catheter Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, District of Arizona

phase: Bellwether verdict and Hicks pretrial proceedings
phaseDetail: November 17 CMO 52 confirms the November 13 conference and sets February 28, 2027 as the cutoff for new direct filings and transfers into MDL 3081. Negotiations for pending cases run through September 1, 2027. Cases with a release or term sheet executed by then can remain pending through March 1, 2028 for settlement paperwork and stipulated dismissal. The order provides for remand or transfer of unresolved cases and does not publish individual payout amounts. A superseding Hicks schedule remains unverified.

keyDates.label: MDL-3081 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized the cases before Judge David G. Campbell in Arizona.

keyDates.label: CMO 46 entered
keyDates.detail: The order addressed trial preparation and retained Miller in the bellwether pool; it is not a trial result.

keyDates.label: Divelbliss verdict filed
keyDates.detail: $40 million compensatory award. No punitive damages.

keyDates.label: Settlement-procedure conference held
keyDates.detail: CMO 52 confirms the conference addressed negotiations and remand or transfer.

keyDates.label: Joint memorandum due
keyDates.detail: Parties must propose reporting, video testimony, and record preparation procedures.

keyDates.label: MDL cutoff for direct filings and transfers
keyDates.detail: This cutoff governs entry into MDL 3081. Individual filings depend on jurisdiction, venue, and applicable filing limits.

keyDates.label: Pending-case negotiation milestone
keyDates.detail: Cases without an executed release or term sheet are subject to remand recommendation or transfer.

keyDates.label: Settlement paperwork and dismissal deadline
keyDates.detail: Applies to cases with a release or term sheet executed by September 1, 2027.

updates.summary: November 17 CMO 52 confirms the November 13 conference and sets February 28, 2027 as the cutoff for new direct filings and transfers into MDL 3081. Negotiations for pending cases run through September 1, 2027. Cases with a release or term sheet executed by then can remain pending through March 1, 2028 for settlement paperwork and stipulated dismissal. The order provides for remand or transfer of unresolved cases and does not publish individual payout amounts.
The Hicks docket includes October expert rulings, the October 26 denial of summary judgment and the affirmative-defense ruling filed November 4.
JPML lists 4,345 pending and 4,636 historical actions in MDL-3081 on November 2, compared with 4,140 pending on October 1.
JPML reports 4,140 pending actions in MDL-3081 on October 1, 2026, up 406 from 3,734 on September 1; 4,420 total historical actions are reported separately.
The filed Divelbliss verdict awarded $40 million in compensatory damages and no punitive damages.
JPML reports 3,734 pending actions and 3,980 historical actions in MDL-3081.
The pending count is unchanged from 3,734 on August 3, 2026.
CMO 46 addressed Cook trial preparation, Miller pool selection and Divelbliss expert briefing. Subsequent outcomes are not verified here.
